dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular ovoid perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior fur to the high-intensity white rings, most notably in the upper-central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is observed, primarily localized in the interstitial gaps between larger macro-annuli and along the posterior-lateral axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the superior-midsection form a distinct obtuse triangle; an additional grouping of high-intensity blobs creates a secondary geometric sequence of four points in a linear configuration ventrally.
